card.name: "Than" after no earlier or no sooner
card.fires_on: The word "than" right after "no earlier" or "no sooner" in dose-timing instructions. Weaker on "exceed" in dose-limit phrases.

modes.label: Minimum interval
modes.description: "than" after "no earlier" or "no sooner", before a time span such as 3 days.

modes.label: Dose limit wording
modes.description: "exceed" in a "do not exceed" weight-based dose limit.
modes.example: 50 to 100 lbs., do not<< exceed>> 75 mg except in severe cases

card.writes: It seems to push toward a time or amount value next, and away from words that mean "required" or "needed".
card.plain: It fires on the "than" in "no earlier than" when a label says how long to wait before repeating a dose.
